notes.title: [v1.7.2] Patch Update – July 5, 2025
notes.content:
Fixed issues caused by missing fonts.

Fixed and improved animations for minions when taking damage or being healed.

Fixed an issue where minions still occupied their original position after moving.

Optimized some animation effects.

Improved certain art assets.
